answer: Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 3 epochs, so holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in lagoon and prism lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the signal graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 478 impostors cost 1045 times the honest price and take 8 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
